ElectionId.description: An election's identifier, unique within its community. A closed alphabet: it appears in the ticket class label `voter/<electionId>` and is framed into every hash a cast is bound to.
ElectionId.title: ElectionId

ElectionListItem.description: One election as a list shows it. vtc/elections/show reads it whole.

ticketHeld.description: Whether the community has issued a ticket for this election to the caller. About the caller only, never anyone else.

title.description: The manifest's `title`, when it has one.

ElectionListItem.title: ElectionListItem

Ext.description: Vendor-namespaced extension object per SPEC.md §4.5.1. Each immediate key MUST be a reverse-DNS namespace; structure under each namespace is opaque to the framework.
Ext.title: Ext

RegistrarState.description: An election's state as its registrar holds it: the ballot box's `ElectionState` once the ballot box has registered the election, or, before that, `pendingRegistration` (the community is still delivering the registration) or `registrationRefused` (the ballot box refused it on a later delivery, and only a cancellation clears it). The first six values are the ballot box's `ElectionState` (voting/_shared/0.1).
RegistrarState.title: RegistrarState

Response.description: Success response to vtc/elections/list/0.2: one page of the elections the caller may see.

nextCursor.description: Continuation token for the next page; pass it as `cursor`. Absent on the last page — never `null`.

schema.description: A member or an administrator pages through the community's elections that the caller may see. The outer document members (id, type, issuer, recipient, issuedAt, expiresAt, proof) are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

cursor.description: An opaque continuation token from a previous response's `nextCursor`, bound to the caller and to `state`; a responder MUST NOT accept a cursor it did not issue.

limit.description: The most items to return; the responder chooses a default and MAY return fewer.
